name: je-corporate-income-tax
description: Jersey ordinary corporate income tax for 2026, including company residence, sector rates, large corporate retailer calculations, tax return duties and the distinction between zero rating and exemption. Use for Jersey company tax, zero ten, retail taper, financial services or corporate tax filing. Includes a statutory retail calculation for a standalone annual period and identifies associated-company and period-length adjustments. Pillar Two is covered separately. Adds ordinary deduction, capital allowance, loss, group-relief and company-payment rules with bounded examples. Distribution allocations and specialist adjustments need transaction-specific verification. This source-cited draft awaits professional review and must not be used to infer that every Jersey company pays no tax.
